tagline: JDownloader 2 with a complete, sleek dark UI out of the box, on a fast Selkies web desktop in your browser. No VNC client, no install.
description: JDownloader 2 with a dark mode GUI and full clipboard support out of the box. The download list, link grabber and settings are all dark, and everything runs on a hardware-accelerated Selkies web desktop. It looks like this from the first start, without tweaking or add-ons.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: JDownloader
